data.name: Hotel Hi! Fundidora
data.address: Av. Francisco I. Madero 2925, Acero, 64580 Monterrey, N.L., Mexico
data.description:
Along a main road in an area with automobile shops, this humble budget hotel is 4 minutes' walk from Fundidora Park, which features museums, Arena Monterrey and the Cintermex convention center. It's 23 km from Monterrey Airport.
The compact, down-to-earth rooms provide flat-screen TVs, air conditioning and en suite bathrooms. Some rooms have colorful accent walls and/or striking images of the city.
Parking and Wi-Fi are available.
